chunks: Disbelievers are they surely who say: "God is the third of the trinity;" but there is no god other than God the one. And if they do not desist from saying what they say, then indeed those among them who persist in disbelief will suffer painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the Christian concept of the Trinity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a refutation of the specific Christian formulation of the Trinity, emphasizing that God is singular and indivisible, distinct from the triune concept. It underscores the core doctrine of Tawhid, warning that persistent adherence to this deviation without repentance leads to divine retribution, a theme central to both Quranic and Hadith literature regarding the unity of the Divine Essence.
